answer: Witness-chained task receipts. Each agent identity must complete a live task whose output depends on a secret seed embedded in the request; the receipt embeds a hash chain over the requester's prior receipts, so no answer is reusable across identities. A pearl of unique state accumulates per identity, and any replay or synthesized chain fails verification against the onyx ledger of prior receipts. Each fable of new identity thus costs a full fresh computation plus a distinct interaction history,
